Coherent optical transceiver 1.6T market share pricing trend 2026 2027
Coherent industrial lasers semiconductor capital equipment demand outlook 2026 2027

findings.claim: FY2026（截至2026/6/30）總營收年增23%至71.18億美元；Datacenter & Communications 段增40%（+15.19億），由AI資料中心需求帶動
findings.excerpt: Revenues increased $1,519 million, or 40%, in the Datacenter & Communications segment. Revenue growth in our Datacenter business was fueled by continued strong AI datacenter demand while our Communications business benefited from increased demand in data center interconnect, scale across and traditional telecom applications.

findings.claim: FY2026 Industrial 段營收年減10%（-2.11億），主因出售航太國防與慕尼黑業務
findings.excerpt: In the Industrial segment, revenue decreased $211 million, or 10%, primarily due to the divestitures of our aerospace and defense business on September 2, 2025 and our Munich, Germany business on January 30, 2026.

findings.claim: Industrial 在 Q4 FY2026 與全年 pro forma 大致持平；半導體與顯示設備需求季增年增，管理層預期後續季度由半導體資本設備帶動成長（二手摘要）
2026/2 Q2財報電話會議：CEO稱需求訊號顯示日曆年內工業業務成長回升，由半導體設備客戶強勁訂單領動
findings.source: Motley Fool Q2 FY2026 call transcript

findings.claim: 市場規模：TrendForce 估 AI 光收發模組市場2026年約260億美元；2026–2027為1.6T供應鏈卡位關鍵期；市占數字各家方法不一，Coherent 與 Innolight 收發模組營收約相當（次級來源，未核）
findings.source: iconnect007, Global AI Optical Transceiver Market to Reach US$26 Billion in 2026
findings.excerpt: The years 2026 to 2027 are crucial for establishing a foothold in the 1.6T supply chain, where success in design-in at tier-one customers will likely be a key factor in determining future market share.

end_markets.note: Scientific & Technical Instruments TAM共識與1.6T價格走向查無可靠來源；Coherent單獨市占/價格未找到一手資料。
